title: Failed paired native cohorts lost their complete activity before broker handoff

evidence.locator: Each run_fault and preceding evaluation_attempt_completed stderr/broker_record; overlapped timestamps or reset-before-sample refusal.

observation: Native paired timing raised ValueError after kernel work, leaving receipt=null and only a short stderr plus counters. The assay had last_activity, but the paired caller did not attach it to the error and the closed worker/broker envelope could not transfer failed-cohort artifacts. A later investigator cannot recover the missing raw interval/correlation sequence from these old records.
proposed_change: Retain a failed paired snapshot with current arm/position, completed pairs, manifests, correctness observations and native activity. Transfer it in a version-2 failed-worker envelope, archive it through the existing BrokerAttempt and validate exact diagnostic-role coverage at replay. Preserve receipt=null and all timing checks.

software_verification.tests: actual strict-overlap guard, actual worker exit, actual command broker temporary-directory handoff and missing-artifact replay refusal; included in 214 focused CPU contracts

promotion_disposition: The diagnostic transport is implemented. Original failures remain missing. Fresh C550 reproduction and timing-cause diagnosis remain required before closing this Finding; no interval tolerance or timer acceptance change.
